caption: The drawing depicts a gold-colored horse in motion, with all four legs off the ground, appearing to be trotting or running. A gold-colored rider is seated on the horse, holding the reins with both hands. The horse and rider are mounted on a horizontal bar that supports the entire figure, with one vertical support connecting from the horse's underside to the bar and another supporting the rear hoof. The composition is centered on a plain, light beige background with no other elements present, and faint areas of discoloration are visible on the left and lower left sides of the background.
title: Metal Weather Vane
